verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions independent security audits, third-party assessments, or published audit reports for the Authy app or its sync/backup protocol. The vendor docs only claim client-side encryption of backups. Published audits are a fair axis for an authenticator app, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the vendor publishes independent security audits of the app and its sync protocol
